name: Shoal Shell
description: A seashell found deep inside the Shoal Cave.

gifts.mapName: Shoal Cave Low Tide Inner Room
gifts.note: Any tide, refills daily. Check the blue stone for a Shoal Shell. After you take it, the stone refills on a new day once you talk to the old man at the cave entrance, who trades 4 Shoal Salt and 4 Shoal Shells for a Shell Bell.
